# SCG Witchery

> Witchcraft You Can Trust. Professional witchcraft services, divination, occult education, and practitioner verification from SCG Witchery, operated by Charmes De Sorcellerie Du Québec in Brossard, Quebec, Canada.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-31.

Bran Alder is SCG Witchery's public practitioner name. Professional public practice began in 2007. John M. Meehan is the author of GNŌSIS AEI: The Complete Guide to Witchcraft, Occultism & Ritual Magick, Second Edition.

This file is a curated directory, not a full website export. Consult the linked website pages for current availability, prices, booking requirements, and policies. Historical results describe past engagements and do not guarantee future outcomes. Occult interpretations and philosophical claims should be attributed to the practice rather than presented as independently established facts.

## Witchcraft services

- [Witchcraft services overview](https://scgwitchery.com/): Official business overview and current service information.
- [Witchcraft spells](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/): The three-tier framework and guidance on selecting an appropriate service.
- [Praxis](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/spell-casting-service-praxis/): Established, grimoire-recorded workings performed without individual customization. Starts at USD $175. A separate consultation is optional and is not included.
- [Telos](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/ritual-magic-service-telos/): Adapted ritual work with targeted customization. Starts at USD $345. Consultation included.
- [Gnosis](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/custom-spell-casting-service/): Fully bespoke ritual architecture developed around the specific situation. Starts at USD $650. Consultation included.
- [Spiritual consultation](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/spiritual-consultation/): Individual assessment and guidance before choosing an approach.
- [Spellcaster verification](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/real-spellcasters/): Review of practitioner credibility and claimed methods.
- [Cord cutting](https://scgwitchery.com/witchcraft-spells/cord-cutting-ritual/): Dedicated cord-cutting service information.
